settings.heading: Questions, answered
settings.text: The questions readers ask most. Anything else, write to me.

settings.question: Is this a paper book?
settings.answer: It is an ebook and an audiobook. The ebook comes as PDF and EPUB, so it opens on a phone, a tablet, a Kindle, a Kobo or a laptop. Replace this with your own formats.

settings.question: How do I get it after paying?
settings.answer: A download link arrives by email straight away, and the files stay in your account so you can download them again.

settings.question: I do not read much now. Is it for me?
settings.answer: Yes. The book is written for people who used to read and stopped. Chapter one asks for twenty pages a day, nothing more.

settings.question: What is the free chapter?
settings.answer: The whole of chapter one, The Twenty Page Day, as a PDF. Leave your email at the top of the page and it arrives in a minute.

settings.question: What if it is not for me?
settings.answer: Write within 30 days and you get every cent back. Replace this with your own terms.

settings.question: Can I buy it for someone else?
settings.answer: Yes. Put their email at checkout, or forward the download email. Write to me if you want a gift note added.

settings.question: Do you offer copies for book clubs or teams?
settings.answer: Yes, at a lower price per copy. Write to me with how many you need.

settings.question: Is there a paperback?
settings.answer: Not yet. Join Marginalia and you will hear first when there is.

settings.heading: Start with chapter one tonight
settings.text: Twenty five minutes of reading and the first habit of the book, free.

settings.success_heading: Chapter one is on its way
settings.success_text: Check your inbox in a minute. If nothing arrives, look in spam.
